Thanks for the recap and for putting the options on the calendar. All sounds right from our discovery:

- Peak throughput: ~150 req/s (sustained spikes up to ~180 for short windows)
- Concurrency: we see sustained concurrency around 30-40, spikes to ~60 during morning rounds
- Average tokens per request: ~200 (chat); longer summarization jobs can be 1k-3k tokens but are batchable/off-peak
- Latency target: P95 <= 100ms for chat (hard), P95 <= 500ms acceptable for summarization jobs

Tue Jul 14 at 10:00 AM PT works for us  I'll block it. I'll also ask engineering to pull a quick QPS/time-of-day CSV to drop into your template.
